items.excerpt: "If I say run, you run," Tetiana tells us. She and her colleague Yasha are escorting us into a city now under constant bombardment from Russian drones, missiles and glide bombs. items.title: Victor Munoz wins LFC's Goal of the Month award for October
items.author: By Chris Shaw
items.excerpt: Victor Munoz has won Liverpool’s Goal of the Month award for October. The Spain international topped our fan poll courtesy of his equalising effort against Brentford in the Premier League. A driving run forward by Munoz was followed by a cut inside and left-footed finish to start a turnaround that led to a 2-1 victory. In second place was Natalia Ramos’ long-range strike at Aston Villa and the first of Bradley Barcola’s hat-trick versus LASK took third.
